amenitiesDescription:
Horizon — the rooftop: An expansive sun deck with a resort-style pool and a separate spa pool, water, skyline and golf course views from sunrise to sunset, custom FENDI Casa cabanas and poolside loungers, two covered summer kitchens with grills and beverage centres, and two outdoor showers set in signature arched coves.

Mezzo — level four, recharge: A Technogym fitness centre for cardio and weight training, an alfresco fitness lawn for personal training, indoor and outdoor yoga and Pilates spaces, a spa with sauna, steam room, cold plunge and salt wall, and a private treatment room with shower and massage beds.

Mezzo — level four, relax: A games lounge with card tables and billiards, a bar and lounge with indoor and outdoor seating, a terrace over the golf course, a resident library, a wine wall, an executive room with boardroom table and A/V, a screening room, a golf simulator lounge, and a private dining room with a gourmet kitchen.

Atrium — the lobby: Porte-cochère arrival under signature Roman columns, a FENDI Casa arched entryway, private reception with concierge, a reception lounge in FENDI Casa furniture, package and mail rooms, 24/7 security and valet, a marina lounge with coffee bar, a marina paseo over the waterway, and a linear park planted in native South Florida flora.
description: Twenty-two residences at 20605 NE 34th Avenue, Aventura. Interiors by FENDI Casa, architecture by Kobi Karp, a private fourteen-slip marina and three levels of amenities. Two homes per floor, from $5M.

investmentThesis:
Avenia pairs FENDI Casa interiors with a twenty-two-home program: two residences to a floor across eleven levels, and four of the twenty-two shown available on the developer's broker portal as of September 2026.

The site is the argument. A canal lot on the edge of a golf course gives every half-floor home three exposures over water, fairway and skyline, and the fourteen-slip private marina takes yachts to eighty feet. Two parking spaces come with every residence and three with each penthouse.

Deposits run twenty percent at contract, ten at groundbreaking, ten at top off and sixty at closing, so sixty percent of the purchase price stays with the buyer until delivery.

name: Avenia Aventura
parking: Two assigned spaces per residence and three per penthouse; secure garage with guest parking, 24/7 valet and bicycle storage
residenceContent:
Twenty-two homes on a canal at the edge of a golf course in Aventura, two to a floor across eleven residential levels. Kobi Karp drew the building with planted terraces stepping up each elevation and a porte-cochère carried on signature Roman columns under a green ceiling. Every residence occupies half a floor and opens off its own private elevator lobby, with three exposures — water, city and fairway — and a dedicated service entrance behind.

Interiors are curated by FENDI Casa with The One Atelier as interior architect, and the maison's signature arch recurs from the entryway through to the residences. Kitchens are FENDI Casa with European stone counters and a Sub-Zero and Wolf suite — panelled refrigeration, wine storage, induction cooktop and convection oven — and a kosher kitchen plan is drawn as an alternative. Primary suites take a private terrace, a spa bathroom with soaking tub and separate water closet, and an Italian-made FENDI-branded walk-in closet with built-in fixtures. Every home carries a full laundry room, integrated smart home control, and pre-wiring for motorised shades.

Floors five to fifteen hold the East and West Residences at 3,505 and 3,494 square feet of interior space, each with 1,345 square feet of terrace — three bedrooms on the east line, four on the west, four and a half baths either way. Level sixteen is given to two half-floor penthouses, Acqua and Terra, at 3,887 and 3,876 square feet with 1,912 square feet of terrace apiece, eleven-foot ceilings, three assigned parking spaces and a private rooftop with its own pool.
